title: Changed helper inventories screened against the packing ceiling (complex-new-helper-inventory)
body:
# Changed helper inventories screened against the packing ceiling (card complex-new-helper-inventory)

Scoped exact obstruction plus one screened lead. No new kappa; the selected record, supplier set and frontier are unchanged. Prepared by Aaron Wang with help from opencode (substantial AI assistance; no model named; no independent human review claimed).

## Scope

Drawn card `complex-new-helper-inventory` (track complex-mechanisms, chooser seed `e64193c0fde4d77694e6b2ad660b009a`, priority revision 6, catalogue SHA-256 `47b42433f5a85809a3aadd29c2c339da2c6ed728e4f7762df6b88bccb7874cf0`, base `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`). Scope status: **unchanged**; `TASK.json.actual_scope` equals the card question byte-for-byte. This is a construction reading of the card's method 1 (propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment), with the completed per-call instance and independent endpoint/rank-bill check of method 2.

Question: can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?

## Result

Two exact statements inside the pinned ceiling model (`research/complex-local-word-ceiling`, m = 73, 896 live families per nine-stage replica, centre charge 64, one unpaid coordinate per live family):

1. The deficit side is closed. The per-call deficit `unpaid * w - centre = 320/9` is fixed by the coverage interface alone and does not depend on the helper inventory or paid profile. Any new local cost interface moves the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio only through the recursive-cost side.
2. The two recorded changed-helper-inventory contracts outside the frozen 25-interface catalogue both move it the wrong way. Their optimistic exact moments (ideal rank-51 idle packing) fall strictly below the selected word's packing ceiling. The smallest falsifying instance, R480, keeps the selected local mass and changes only the helper width inventory and children split, and already fails.

One comparison lead survives: the same-inventory U10 profile direction family (PR 987) strictly beats the ceiling, but only by at most 0.0817% relative at its nonnegativity boundary. It is not a helper-inventory change, no word realizing it is known here, and it sits far below the target scale and inside the 0.87% packing headroom.

## Exact screens (grid 1e-12 certified brackets)

| Contract | Per-call profile (rank: children) | Ceiling bracket | Verdict vs selected |
|---|---|---|---|
| selected word | 1:2412, 2:418, 3:432, 4:142, 5:82, 8:8 | 0.001690054109 to 0.001690054110 | baseline |
| R489 (PR 1004) | 1:2463, 2:388, 3:429, 4:166, 5:70, 8:8 | 0.001683186050 to 0.001683186051 | fails, at least 0.406% below |
| R480 (PR 1005) | 1:2412, 2:418, 3:418, 4:170, 5:68, 8:8 | 0.001689769942 to 0.001689769943 | fails, at least 0.0168% below |
| U10 direction t = 1 | 1:2412, 2:418, 3:436, 4:134, 5:86, 8:8 | 0.001690135316 to 0.001690135317 | beats by at least 0.0048% |
| U10 family argmax t = 17 | 1:2412, 2:418, 3:500, 4:6, 5:150, 8:8 | 0.001691435705 to 0.001691435706 | beats by at least 0.0817% |

Margin is the acceptance gate's strict one: a candidate beats only if its whole certified bracket lies above the selected bracket. Every verdict is bracket-separated exact arithmetic, not a float comparison. The U10 family is `selected + t * (3:+4, 4:-8, 5:+4)` at constant local mass 5,586, screened for every integer t from -4 to 17 (17 is the last t with a nonnegative rank-4 count); the ceiling rises monotonically in t.

## Rank bill and deficit (method 2 instance, independently verified)

Every screened contract closes its per-call bill exactly: total delivered mass `72 * (896/9) + 64 = 7232`; paid local mass plus ideal idle mass equals 7,232 (R489: 5,604 + 1,628; the others: 5,586 + 1,646); capacity minus delivered equals `73 * (896/9) - 7232 = 320/9`, the invariant deficit. The verifier recomputes the moment on two independent paths (exact fractions and a separate `math.log`/`math.exp` implementation) and checks that the independent float root lands inside each exact bracket.

## What is not established

No word realizing any U10-family profile is constructed; no physical owner map, hosting, precision or outer invoice is replayed; the arbitrary-dirty scalar identities of the R489/R480 words are inherited from their own packages and were not replayed here. Nothing here bounds helper inventories outside the two screened contracts. An optimistic passing relaxation is not acceptance; a construction round needs the family-level budget and obligation gate in `docs/research/research-family-status.md`.

## Verification

Package: `research/helper-inventory-moment-seede64193c0/` (registered replay, Python 3.12, standard library).

- `python3.12 -I -B research/helper-inventory-moment-seede64193c0/verify.py` prints `PASS_HELPER_INVENTORY_MOMENT_SCREEN selected 1690054109/1000000000000 R489 1683186051/1000000000000 R480 1689769943/1000000000000 argmax U10_t+17 338287141/200000000000 blobs git-blobs-match`.
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/helper-inventory-moment-seede64193c0 --check-only` prints `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)`.
- Full registered replay prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/helper-inventory-moment-seede64193c0 outcome=partial`.
- `python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/helper-inventory-moment-seede64193c0 --ref HEAD` prints `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` with commit `18f7accb8297610e3ef0489c9ca51b18944c650c` and 8 files.

Controls: the pinned engine reproduces the selected word's ceiling; one extra rank-1 child strictly lowers it; an over-mass profile and an idle rank cap of 52 are rejected for the recorded reasons; `RESULT.json` is byte-matched on every replay; when git history is available the embedded R489/R480 profile and inventory constants are cross-checked against the pinned SPEC blobs at PR 1005 head `779e80aef469bc3a28b19f1adde199871a9a22e3` and fail on drift. The R480 and R489 vectors also byte-match the digests recorded by the heterogeneous-owner-assembly controls.

## Coordination

Pair-collision pass over discussions 1166 and 1317 found no live claim on this card's object: philippeVV's helper-endpoint inventory claim (expired 2026-10-14 05:53 UTC) was released with negative results in its k8-inventory-screens package, and navinor's queue-ceiling census claim (expired about 2026-10-14 07:00 UTC) covers different objects; neither runs the moment screens here. No advance CLAIM was posted; this bounded session finished in one run. Prior readings of this card cover helper terminal frames (`research/selected-k8-unrestricted-ends`, PR 1995/PR 2013) and leave the changed-inventory axis open; that axis is what this package takes. The parallel m=6 both-odd cover question is a different object and untouched.
